content: cert-manager with Cloudflare DNS-01 ClusterIssuer producing wildcard certs in k3s/Traefik is a well-documented homelab pattern (Techno Tim, Stonegarden, Lachlan Mitchell). Alternative: terminate TLS at the external reverse proxy (NPM) using its own DNS-01 wildcard cert and forward HTTP upstream. Wildcard cert for Traefik should live where Traefik reads it (kube-system default TLS store on k3s); ClusterIssuer preferred over namespaced Issuer.
